title: Event Envelope (Wire Format)
description: Single event as it transits the relay. The relay sees: sender fingerprint, channel, prev_hash, this_hash, sig, ciphertext blob and its size. The relay does NOT see plaintext.

sender.description: Publisher fingerprint (hash of Ed25519 public key)

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous envelope's this_hash; all-zeros for seq=0

this_hash.description: SHA-256(prev_hash || sender || channel || seq || iat || ciphertext)

iat.description: Publisher's unix timestamp; relay ALSO records its own arrival timestamp

wrap.description: Wrapped per-channel symmetric key under harbor key (base64)

sig.description: Ed25519 over this_hash by the publisher key

card.description: The bearer's harbor card or attenuated chain. Relay verifies before accepting publish.
